## 赛制说明

本次比赛共有 **12名选手** 参加，按当前积分排定种子（1–12号种子），分为 **A/B/C/D** 四个小组，每组3人。

- **小组赛**：组内单循环，每人2场；每组积分前2名晋级1/4决赛，共8人，交叉配对 A1-B2 / B1-A2 / C1-D2 / D1-C2
- **比赛规则**：每场比赛均采取五局三胜，局间休息时间为45s，赢一场得1分，败者不得分；确定组内排名时先比积分，再比净胜局，再比净胜球，若最后仍不分上下，则抽签决定第一第二或第二第三

## Format

This event has **12 entrants**. They are seeded on current points (seeds 1–12) and split into **four groups A/B/C/D** of three.

- **Group stage**: a round robin within each group, two matches each; the top two on points in each group advance to the quarter-finals (eight players in total), cross-paired A1-B2 / B1-A2 / C1-D2 / D1-C2
- **Match rules**: every match is best of five games, with 45s between games; a win is worth 1 point and a loss is worth none. Group rankings are decided first on points, then on games won minus games lost, then on points won minus points conceded; if everything is still level, a draw decides first from second and second from third
